data.raw_text:
RIP, gone but not dead, what doesn’t kill you makes you stronger. 

The AIP Alaska, independent party was shut down and buried, But the Alaskan Party Rises and 60% of Us Are Ready to Explode!

Alaskans, wake the hell up and get pissed off for this one’s personal!
The Alaskan Independence Party didn’t die in battle against the feds or the two-party cartel. 

No, it was murdered from within by a handful of ignorant, despairing party officers who had zero grasp of our state’s history, our problems, or our God-given rights. 

In December 2025, a tiny 3-member board held a secret little vote to “dissolve” the AIP – no full membership ballot, no statewide convention, no input from the 19,000+ Alaskans who were still signed up. 

They called it “spiritually dead” while the body was still breathing!

That wasn’t leadership – that was a backroom betrayal that violated their own by-laws, the democratic process our Alaska Constitution demands for political association, and the spirit of the election statutes that are supposed to protect parties from exactly this kind of bureaucratic knife in the back. 

The Division of Elections rubber-stamped it anyway, and just like that, Alaska’s only homegrown party was erased. But you can’t kill an idea that’s rooted in truth.

Enter the very first Thomas Massie Bob Bird and the real fighters rebuilding it stronger as the ALASKAN PARTY – same mission, cleaned-up name, by-laws mostly intact and already approved by the Division of Elections. 

This sounds drops from bob sounds a lot like me  “I hate all parties” undeclared voters who signed up by mistake, plus the dead and moved-away names that have cluttered the rolls for years.

And what does the Alaskan Party stand for? 

Let Bob Bird lay it out plain,
“Our 1958 statehood vote was flawed from the jump. The U.N. Charter listed Alaska and Hawaii as Non-Self-Governing Territories, just like Guam, Puerto Rico, and the Virgin Islands. We were offered only ‘statehood or stay a territory.’ 

Commonwealth and independence should’ve been on the ballot too. 

The Philippines didn’t ‘secede’ in 1946 they exercised treaty rights and kept U.S. military protection and the right for their citizens to serve in our armed forces. We got short-changed.”

Federal ownership of 65% of our land mass is straight-up unconstitutional – Article I, Section 8, Clause 17 and the 10th Amendment say the feds can only own land for specific purposes, not to turn Alaska into their giant welfare ward. It kills jobs, stifles development, and keeps us dependent exactly like territorial days. 

We honor ANCSA and Native lands (10% of the state), but the rest belongs to Alaskans – period.

We’re also done with the locally distorted 1955 constitution and the clown-show laws other parties won’t touch: Ranked-Choice Voting must die, Grand Jury rights restored, abortion funding fixed, property protections against federal giveaway, voting integrity – the whole list. 

The Alaskan Party is calling a real convention to hammer out a platform that actually means something.

Here’s the part that should light your fire, Alaska. Over 60% of us are undeclared or independent voters – 360,000+ out of roughly 570,000-600,000 total. 

We crush both the Republicans and Democrats combined! 

Libertarians sick of their party sliding left, conservatives tired of RINOs, every limited-government Alaskan who ever sympathized with the AIP but wouldn’t join because of primary rules – that excuse evaporated with RCV in 2020.

First, Alaska Always.

This isn’t a third party, Alaskans – this is the sleeping giant majority waking up. The independents and undeclared outnumber the party machines two-to-one. 

Don’t let a handful of backstabbing bureaucrats bury the fight. Re-register as Alaskan Party. Contact Bob Bird. Build this movement.

The time is NOW. Alaska First – or we stay slaves in our own state forever. Let’s go!
